description:
Digital Marketing Strategist & Scheduler Intern


Part-Time | Remote | U.S. Residents Only


Company Description


Meta Viable Solutions (MVS) is a strategic operations and business transformation consulting firm providing Fractional COO leadership, operations consulting, strategic and digital transformation, leadership development, corporate training, and business growth support.


We are seeking a creative, analytical, and highly organized Digital Marketing Strategist & Scheduler Intern to support our digital presence, content strategy, brand awareness, and audience growth. This role is ideal for someone who is well versed in major social media platforms, understands how platform behavior and audience trends influence content performance, and can turn research and data into practical recommendations for stronger digital visibility.


The ideal candidate is independent, detail-oriented, collaborative, positive, and eager to learn. This person should also be comfortable serving as a thought partner to the team by bringing forward ideas, identifying opportunities, and helping us make informed marketing decisions. This is a remote, part-time internship with a minimum six-month commitment. College credit may be available.


Responsibilities



 Assist with the planning, creation, scheduling, and publishing of digital content across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
 Maintain an organized content calendar and ensure approved content is scheduled and published accurately, consistently, and on time.
 Develop and refine captions, posts, graphics, short-form content, and other digital marketing materials aligned with the MVS brand.
 Increase brand awareness, engagement and response rates, and prospects through strategic campaigns.
 Monitor social media and digital analytics, identify performance patterns, and prepare clear reports and presentations for the team.
 Use platform data, audience behavior, engagement trends, and industry research to recommend optimal posting times, content approaches, and channel strategies.
 Conduct ongoing research on social media trends, platform updates, competitor activity, digital marketing best practices, and relevant industry developments.
 Support the execution and optimization of digital and social media campaigns.
 Conduct pre-campaign research and assist with reviewing post-campaign results, takeaways, and opportunities for improvement.
 Support email marketing, newsletters, digital campaigns, and other online marketing initiatives as needed.
 Research strategic media, partnership, promotional, and visibility opportunities that may support brand awareness and business development.
 Help maintain marketing documentation, campaign information, reporting, schedules, content files, and quality-control processes.
 Contribute ideas and recommendations as a thought partner to the CEO and team, helping translate research, data, and trends into practical marketing actions.

Qualifications



 Current college student, recent graduate, or early-career professional interested in digital marketing, communications, branding, social media, analytics, or business development.
 Well- versed in major social media platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube, with an understanding of how content and audience behavior differ by platform.
 Experience with social media content, scheduling, digital marketing, or campaign support preferred.
 Strong analytical mindset with the ability to review social media metrics, identify trends, and translate data into useful recommendations.
 Comfortable preparing reports, summaries, and presentations that communicate marketing performance and strategic insights clearly.
 Strong research skills and ability to stay current on social media changes, digital trends, algorithms, audience behavior, and marketing best practices.
 Experience with Canva, social media scheduling tools, email marketing platforms, analytics tools, or similar digital applications is preferred.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail.
 Highly organized with strong project and time-management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
 Independent self-starter who can take ownership of assigned work while also collaborating effectively as part of a team.
 Positive, professional attitude with a willingness to learn, receive feedback, and continuously improve.
 Resourceful and proactive, with the confidence to bring forward ideas, questions, and recommendations as a thought partner.
 Reliable and responsive, with consistent communication and follow-through.
 English proficiency required.

Experience with Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite/Ads Manager, SEO, email marketing platforms, digital advertising, public relations, or media outreach is a plus but is not required.


What You Will Gain



 Hands-on experience in digital marketing, social media strategy, scheduling, and brand development.
 Experience using analytics, research, and trends to inform marketing decisions.
 Opportunities to build reports, presentations, work samples, and portfolio-ready experience.
 Exposure to business development, consulting, entrepreneurship, and executive leadership.
 Mentorship and guidance from the CEO and other experienced professionals.
 Experience contributing ideas and strategic recommendations as part of a collaborative team.

Schedule & Work Environment



 Part-time internship.
 Remote position.

Flexible schedule; however, interns must be available for scheduled virtual meetings and occasional in-person meetings when appropriate based on location.


Minimum six-month commitment.


U.S. residents only.


How to Apply


Please submit:



 Resume in PDF or Word format.
 Brief statement explaining your interest in the position.
 Portfolio, work samples, or links to relevant content, if available.
 Relevant professional or social media profiles, if applicable.
 One professional or academic reference.
 Earliest available start date and anticipated end date.
 Weekly availability and approximate number of hours available.

Candidates should apply only if they can consistently dedicate the required time to the internship, communicate reliably, and meet agreed-upon deadlines.


Job Type: Internship


Application Question(s):



 Are you 18 years or older?
 How many hours a week are you able to dedicate to this internship?
 Are you a student looking for student credit through this internship? If yes, what is required?
 This is a remote internship with part time hours where you can receive great recommendations and experience. Are you still interested?
 This is a 6 month minimum internship. Are you able to dedicate this time (please answer honestly)?
 Do you know how to write effective social media content/captions with optimized hashtags?
 What social media management platforms are you proficient in?

What experience do you have scheduling and posting content and what results have you seen in regard to increased brand awareness, engagement, sales, etc (numeric values)?



 Why are you interested in this internship and working at this company and how does this role fit into your future goals?

 Facebook: 4 years (Required)
 Social media marketing/ management: 2 years (Required)
 TikTok: 1 year (Required)
 Social media strategy: 1 year (Preferred)
